summary: Iteration 37 — full test of the 3 new features (Community B2B, GLOBAL timer alarm, Batch Traceability) + regression. BACKEND: new pytest suite /app/backend/tests/test_iter37_community.py, 13/13 PASS (public anon list without _id and liked_by_me/can_delete=false; 401 gating on create/like for anon; create+persist; empty text 400; invalid category falls back to 'consiglio'; like toggle 1->0; like 404; comment create+persist; empty comment 400; non-owner delete 403 + can_delete false for fornaio@; owner delete 200 + verified removal; delete 404). FRONTEND (mobile 430x900): (A) COMMUNITY all PASS — learn-tab-community reachable and feed loaded ANONYMOUSLY; anon click on community-submit opens auth-modal; login from the modal succeeds and modal closes; post created (category consiglio, author 'Michele') and appears in community-feed; like 0->1 turns red (#E4572E) and retoggle back to 0; comment sent and rendered; category filters correctly hide/show (foto/ricetta/domanda hide the consiglio post, consiglio/all show it); community-photo-btn present; community-delete removes the post and it stays gone after reload. (B) GLOBAL TIMER ALARM — KEY FIX CONFIRMED 3 ways: (1) seeded timer (endsAt=+6s) expired while on HOME -> timer-alarm-overlay appeared with 'Tempo scaduto / AllarmeGlobale', timer-alarm-dismiss closed it; (2) alarm fired while on the Ricette tab; (3) TRUE E2E: logged in as admin, Maestro>Passo 3>maestro-tool-timer, created 'Prova' 1', left via maestro-back-btn, navigated to nav-tab-home and WAITED — the overlay fired globally after ~60s showing 'Prova', dismiss worked, no re-fire after 4s. (C) TIMER CONTROLS regression all PASS: timer-preset-cottura -> 39:59 (40'), toggle pause froze 39:59->39:59 over 4s, resume counted 39:59->39:57, reset restored 40:00, wall-clock 39:59 -> 39:48 after ~11s outside the tool, localStorage 'mikilab_timers' persisted, timer-remove deleted the card. (D) BATCH TRACEABILITY all PASS: batch-add opens batch-form, batch-code auto-generated 'LOT-260822-ZHK' (regex LOT-YYMMDD-XXX OK), save with empty product correctly rejected (no card, form stays open), full form saved -> batch-card with code/product/dates/flour/flourlot/qty/operator/note rendered, batch-qr-<id> is a real data:image/png;base64 (8910 chars), batch-print present, localStorage 'mikilab_batches' persisted, batch-remove deletes. (E) REGRESSION: 5-step wizard navigable, maestro-tool-market (step 1) and maestro-tool-meteo (step 4) open with zero error elements.

ui_bugs.issue: The welcome dialog is shown on EVERY page load whenever an onboarding profile exists: showIntro = !!getProfile() and IntroGuide never reads/writes any 'seen' flag (mikilab_seen_intro is unused in the code). After reload/login the modal reappeared and its Radix DialogOverlay (z-50) intercepted pointer events, blocking bottom-nav clicks until dismissed. Pre-existing, not caused by this iteration.

Console error spam on every app load: the effect `if (ringing.length>0) startAlarm(); else stopAlarm();` runs on mount and stopAlarm() calls navigator.vibrate(0) before any user gesture -> Chrome logs 'Blocked call to navigator.vibrate...' 3x per load. Guard the vibrate call (only when an alarm was actually started).

issues: The faint avatar watermark behind the Radio/Parla FAB strip above the bottom nav is still visible (reported in iteration_36) - confirm intentional

Community composer: the 'Pubblica' button is enabled for anonymous users (by design, it opens the login modal) - acceptable, but the textarea placeholder 'Accedi per pubblicare…' is the only hint; consider a clearer inline CTA

action_items: LOW: guard navigator.vibrate(0) in TimerContext.stopAlarm to remove per-load console errors
MEDIUM (pre-existing): persist an intro-seen flag (e.g. localStorage 'mikilab_seen_intro') so IntroGuide is not shown on every reload and its overlay does not block navigation
critical_code_review_comments: GET /api/community/posts returns up to 500 posts with all comments embedded and no pagination/limit param — payload will grow unbounded; add ?limit/?skip and cap comments returned.

POST /api/community/posts has no length limit on text (and no rate limiting), so a single user can store arbitrarily large documents; add a max_length on CommunityPostReq.text/CommunityCommentReq.text via Pydantic Field.

Community.jsx like/remove/comment swallow errors with empty catch blocks — a failed like/delete gives the user no feedback (delete only mutates local state on success, which is fine, but a 403/500 is silent). Add toast.error like submit() does.
TimerContext expiry effect depends on `tri` (recreated each render); harmless due to the early return but wrapping in useCallback avoids per-render work.
BatchTraceability regenerates ALL QR data URLs sequentially on every `batches` change; fine for small lists but O(n) work per add/delete — memoize per-id.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of tested flows (Community, global alarm, timer controls, batch traceability, market/meteo regression)

seed_data_creation: Backend: TEST_ community posts created and deleted by the pytest suite (cleanup verified). Frontend: 'TEST_UI post iterazione 37' created and deleted via UI; localStorage mikilab_timers / mikilab_batches entries created and removed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Correct testids: bottom nav is nav-tab-{home,ricette,maestro,impara,diagnosi} (NOT nav-tab-learn). Timer time display is 'timer-time-<id>' (not 'timer-time'). Maestro tool locations: market=Passo 1, timer=Passo 3, meteo=Passo 4, lotti=Passo 5. Setup: add_init_script with mikilab_onboarding={done:true,type:'panificio'} then close [data-testid=intro-close-btn] (it reappears on EVERY load — its overlay blocks bottom-nav clicks, always dismiss it after any reload). Global timer alarm can be tested fast by seeding localStorage mikilab_timers with endsAt=Date.now()+6000, running:true, notified:false and staying on a non-Timer screen. All 3 new features verified working; nothing open except the two minor items above.
rca_of_the_issue: No functional defect found in this iteration. The previously reported limitation (alarm only fired on Timer remount) is fixed: the ticking/expiry/ringing engine now lives in TimerProvider mounted at app level in App.js, with the alarm overlay rendered at z-[90] as a sibling of {children}, so expiry is detected and the overlay/sound fire regardless of the active tab or tool.
